task: perf: league-schedule-generator repeated searches in two test files; bestCarryOverRounds checks counts before searching

doc_friction.issue: A Stop hook asks to commit uncommitted changes while a background before/after timing run is using git stash on the same files; committing mid-run would have made the 'before' run time the new code. Timing 'before' from a git archive copy avoids the conflict, and is worth saying in prompts/perf/prompt-0.md.

goal: cut the slowest venture suite's time without weakening a test
notes: Metric: CPU and wall time of league-schedule-generator tests, node --test on this 4-core container, nothing else running. Per file alone, before (git stash) vs after back to back: best-of-k 35.8 -> 24.6 s, floor-priced 97.2 -> 91.1 s; pool test 23.0 -> 11.1 s, choice test 26.1 -> 18.7 s (spec reporter). Whole suite, node --test '*.test.mjs': before (git archive of d475aabdb) 173.1 s wall / 457.0 s user, after 171.4 s / 444.8 s; an earlier stash pair gave 173.0/451 before and 175.7/455 after, so the suite-level gain is within noise: the suite already uses ~2.6 of 4 cores, so 12-17 s of CPU is worth ~5 s of wall. Longest-file-first ordering: 167.4 s (~4 s). Outcome is partial because the suite wall did not measurably move. Mutation checks: wrong serial pick-0 among and order-dependent combine both fail the pool test; floor-priced seasons let into the choice pool are not caught (nor were they by the old test). 553/553 pass after.
